meta.title: Images
meta.subtitle: Convert, compress, resize, crop and vectorize images
meta.pageSubtitle: Work with images without uploading to a server

converter.title: Converter
converter.icoHint: ICO: 16 × 16, 32 × 32 and 48 × 48 px in one file. Aspect ratio and transparency are preserved. The largest image is selected when reading ICO.

crop.title: Crop
crop.drop: Drop one image here or click to select
crop.limits: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF · One file up to 20 MB · Up to 16 MP and 16,384 px per side
crop.aspectHint: Enter whole numbers from 1 to 1000 for both sides.
crop.transformHint: Zoom changes the preview only. Rotation refits the frame within the image using the selected aspect ratio.

outputErrors.settings: Enter a positive whole-number size in pixels.
outputErrors.pixels: Output exceeds 16 MP or 16,384 px per side.

errors.unsupported: Choose JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF for cropping. ICO and GIF are not supported.
errors.pixels: Image exceeds 16 MP or 16,384 px per side.

uploadLimits: Up to 20 files · 20 MB per file · 100 MB total

vectorize.title: Vectorization
vectorize.shortHint: SVG for logos and simple graphics. Photos are approximate.
vectorize.hint: Produces SVG with vector paths. Best for logos, icons and simple graphics. Photos and complex gradients are approximate; SVG may be much larger than the original file.
vectorize.limits: Tracing uses a copy of up to 262,144 pixels and 1024 px per side. SVG retains the original dimensions. Maximum SVG size: 5 MB. Small details and partial transparency may change.

resize.title: Resize
resize.fitShort: Fields follow the first file's proportions. Each file fits within these bounds.
resize.exactShort: All files get these exact dimensions; images may stretch.
resize.percentShort: 50% halves dimensions, 100% keeps them, 200% doubles them.
resize.fitHint: Fields are linked using the first image in the list. Each file fits within these bounds without cropping. Upscaling is allowed.
resize.exactHint: Every file receives exactly this width and height. Images may be stretched.
resize.percentHint: Scale applies to each original dimension: 50% halves it, 100% keeps it, 200% doubles it.
resize.switchHint: Switching to percentages uses the first file's scale, or its width scale when stretching. Switching back sets pixel bounds from that file and enables aspect ratio preservation. Other files may change – check their planned dimensions in the list.
resize.limits: Output: 1–16,384 px per side, up to 16 MP. Scale: 0.1–1000%.

compression.title: Compression
compression.shortHint: Lower quality usually means smaller files. PNG stays lossless.
compression.qualityHint: Lower quality usually produces smaller files. Applies to JPG, WebP and AVIF. Format and dimensions are preserved.
compression.pngHint: PNG is optimised without loss. Quality does not apply to PNG. Results may be larger – the processed file is downloaded.

switchMode.question: Switch modes? Uploaded files, settings and results in the current mode will be discarded. Any processing in progress will be cancelled.

limits: Up to 20 files, 20 MB per file, 100 MB total. Up to 16 MP and 16,384 px per side. GIF is not supported. Animation and metadata are not preserved.
drop: Drop images here or click to select
